feed_state.phase_status: Must check phase stability at chosen operating conditions

product_specifications.scope: eventual process product; not extractor outlet
product_specifications.classification: task design requirement matching the source purity target

constraints: No arbitrary component split as substitute for separation physics
Do not assume the original plant capacity
Account for material loss as well as enrichment
task_inputs.request: Identify a defensible next separation operation, explain its physical basis and the evidence needed to decide its operating conditions.

reviewed_target.obstacle: Non-ideal mixture and reported azeotropic behaviour constrain a simple distillation-only route. Actual feasibility requires mixture equilibrium analysis.
reviewed_target.physical_mechanism: Liquid-liquid partitioning can transfer ethanol into an aqueous phase and enrich the ester-rich phase; conditioned feeds may change phase compositions.
reviewed_target.rationale_classification: author-stated; Lab shortlist is provisional engineering synthesis

requirements: Tie-line/phase stability data at overall composition and temperature
Ester recovery and ethanol removal targets
Cooling availability and integrated duty assessment

excluded_operations_with_reasons.operation: Assume a single ordinary distillation achieves final purity
excluded_operations_with_reasons.reason: Not justified by the reported azeotropic behaviour; needs a feasible composition path.

reviewed_target.purpose_in_sequence: Change composition to make downstream purification feasible; final product purity may require further operations.
verification_required: Validate a mixture property model against independent VLE/LLE data.
Calculate overall composition after water addition; check phase stability and tie lines before choosing extractor stages.
Calculate phase flows, ester recovery and ethanol removal at justified conditions.
Check downstream feasibility and overall energy/material implications for the small shortlist.
conditions_changing_selection: No two-liquid region at the actual composition
Large ester losses to aqueous phase
Different feed composition or impurity limits
missing_information: Independent tie-line tables and parameter reuse rights
Complete model parameter sets and validity ranges
Recovery target, water quality and impurity requirements
Extractor stage/efficiency data and utility conditions
